content:
sara: FYI main CI just flipped red right after merge of #4573. gpu-smoke allocs failing on a few shards, looks like an allocator fallthrough. pinging @kevin oncall and @matt for infra bits. :eyes:
kevin: grabbing this. which job exactly? can you paste the failing task id?
sara: job: `gpu-smoke/matrix/step-alloc` — failed 3/5 shards. Link: https://ci.redwood.example/4789/jobs/2321 :link:
ci-bot: automated: pipeline main - stage gpu-smoke - FAIL (exit 137)
matt: on it. can you run `kubectl logs -n ci ci-runner-2321 -c runner` and paste last 50 lines? might be OOM or failed mmap.
sara: pasted logs below:
```
I0321 03:14:52.123 allocator.cpp:402] Alloc request: 14.2GB
E0321 03:14:52.124 allocator.cpp:457] Fallback path hit: alloc fallthrough - no compatible slab
E0321 03:14:52.125 runtime.cc:88] Fatal: failed to allocate tensor KV cache
*** Aborted at 1616392492 (unix time) try "date -d @1616392492" if you are using GNU date ***
```
olivia: hmm fallthrough suggests a change in slab sizing or new allocation pattern. #4573 touched kv-cache prefetch logic?
sara: yes, PR changed prefetch window and added a small buffer. author is @jen.
jen: hey — I can dig in. my change intentionally increased prefetch for large-seq workloads; didn't expect this to affect small-shard smoke.
kevin: two paths — quick mitigation is to temporarily revert that prefetch bump or adjust allocator config in CI. which is faster?
matt: fastest is a CI config override: reduce prefetch window via ENV in the job. I'll open a hotfix pipeline change.
jen: I can also prepare a minimal revert PR for #4573 if needed.
sara: @matt can you trigger a rerun with ENV PREFETCH_WINDOW=8 on the gpu-smoke job? If that passes we can roll forward with config change and follow up with a more robust allocator fix.
matt: triggering rerun now: `ci rerun --job 2321 --env PREFETCH_WINDOW=8` :gear:
ci-bot: queued rerun: https://ci.redwood.example/4789/jobs/2321/rerun-2
ci-bot: rerun started
olivia: also leaving a note to run `git bisect` locally if rerun is flaky — but since it happened post-merge, starting with rerun + quick revert is fine.
ci-bot: rerun stage gpu-smoke - PASS on 4/5 shards, one shard still hit alloc fallthrough, overall job: FAIL
sara: ok partial improvement. @jen can you try a narrower change: only increase prefetch for seq_len >= 1024 and keep default otherwise?
jen: will do. creating PR now and will flag for fast review: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4601
kevin: in parallel, @matt please add a temporary job patch to pin smaller slab sizes for smoke. add it as a hotfix in the ci config repo so we can unblock other merges.
matt: done, submitted ci override: https://github.com/redwood/ci-config/commit/8a7bcd - will roll out in 2min.
ci-bot: ci-config apply succeeded. new runs will pick up override.
sara: thanks all. action items: jen - narrow PR (in flight), matt - ci override (done), kevin - monitor oncall, olivia - follow up allocator telemetry to catch similar regressions. I'll leave this thread open til next green on main. :white_check_mark:
